publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Antennas, Propagation and EM Theory (ISAPE)
abstract: The main purpose of this work is to study the sea surface SAR imaging in large scene at large squint based on the refined facet scattering field model (RFSFM) together with the improved Nonlinear Chirp Scaling algorithm. The precise azimuth compression is obtained by considering the effect of the higher order term on the azimuth phase. The results show that in large squint angle, the sea surface texture features can be seen clearly from the SAR image, the correctness of the improved method is proved.

articleTitle: Wide-swath Ocean Radar Altimeter Based on InSAR
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Antennas, Propagation and EM Theory (ISAPE)
abstract: This dissertation makes an in-depth study on Spaceborne Ocean Radar Altimeter which can monitor the ocean in all-weather conditions round the clock. It can provide the sea level height, significant wave height and backscatter coefficient of the ocean, which make it the most effective sensor of researching the marine environment dynamics and all kinds of submarine structure division. Considering conventional radar altimeter can only measure sea surface height under the satellite, this new altimeter applies the Cross-Track InSAR technique to measure the height of wide swath ocean and proposes a research program of new wide swath ocean radar altimeter which not only can satisfy the requirements of high accuracy range measurement but also has the advantage of wide swaths.

articleTitle: The Analysis Method for the Mechanical Radiator with Converse Magneto-electric Effect
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Antennas, Propagation and EM Theory (ISAPE)
abstract: The theoretical analysis method for the laminated composites as a VLF radiator is given. The relation between the acoustic wave inside the material and EM wave outside is established. In condition of the typical material parameters given in other published work, the computed equivalent magnetic dipole moment with the method is in substantial agreement with the result from the experiment in preceding work. The calculated near field in the range less than 100 m is given for free space and half space condition. The field intensity decays with r3, and the magnetic flux intensity of more than 10 fT at 100 m can be obtained for both situations. This mechanical radiator has potential applications in near field communications at VLF band or above.

articleTitle: A Reconfigurable Wideband Antenna Decoupling Structure by Mode Cancellation Method
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Antennas, Propagation and EM Theory (ISAPE)
abstract: A novel reconfigurable wideband mutual decoupling structure is presented in this paper. By inserting lumped reactance components between two E-plane broadband <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$L$</tex>-probe microstrip patch antennas, the parallel resonator composed of inductors and capacitors can reduce the mutual coupling based on common and differential modes cancellation method. To demonstrate the decoupling methodology, a dual-antenna array with proposed structure model is built up and simulated in commercial software HFSS. Simulated results show that a decoupling bandwidth of about 300 MHz with the S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">21</inf> less than -25 dB has been achieved at different resonant frequencies. Especially, the mutual coupling can be reduced by near 35 dB, from -15 dB to -50 dB, at both 3.76 GHz and 4.51 GHz. Consequently, by adjusting the inductance and capacitance values to shift the resonant frequencies, an overall decoupling bandwidth of approximately 37.5% (S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">21</inf>≤ -25 dB) has been achieved from 3.5 GHz to 5 GHz, while the whole operating frequency band of the dual-antenna system is 3.23 ~ 5.11 GHz.

articleTitle: A Wideband Conical Log Spiral Antenna with Broad Circularly Polarized Beam
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Antennas, Propagation and EM Theory (ISAPE)
abstract: A wideband conical log spiral antenna is proposed in this communication. The antenna is composed of two arms that are wrapped around each other in a log-periodic manner. It is excited by a microstrip feed printed on the opposite side of the substrate having a dielcetric constant of 2.65 and thickness of 1mm, which is regard as a balun, providing the antenna with the appropriate impedance matching between the two arms. A parametric study is performed for providing practical design guidelines. The simulation results indicate that an impedance bandwidth for VSWR ≤ 2.0 from 3.2GHz to 7GHz is covered. Stable radiation pattern with broad beam-width is maintained among the working frequencies. In addition, a flexural structure is devised to reduce the size of the antenna.. Compared with the traditional helical antenna, the antenna has a wide band and a broad beamwidth. The results indicate that the electric characteristics of the antenna meet the application requirements in working frequency.

articleTitle: The Variation Characteristics of the Spread-F Occurrences at Xi'an in Northwest China
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Antennas, Propagation and EM Theory (ISAPE)
abstract: Ionospheric spread-F is a subject widely studied by scholars at home and abroad in recent decades. Its occurrence probability is affected by solar activity, geomagnetic activity, season and other factors. Due to its geographical location, Xi'an has become one of the most representative cities in Northwest China. Therefore, studying the variation characteristics of spread-F occurrence probabilities in Xi'an has important strategic significance for ionospheric research in China. This paper introduces the ionoapheric observation data of Xi”an (34.13°N, 108.83°E) in the mid-latitude of China, and studies the occurrence rate and monthly and seasonal variation characteristics of spread-F during 2011. FSF and RSF frequently occurred during summer at Xi”an. The results show that in the middle latitude, the start time of spread-F is about 21 LT and continues to 05 LT. Both the higher occurrences of FSF and RSF are mainly appeared at 22, Oland 04 local times. The probability of RSF occurring at some time in winter is higher than that in spring and autumn. Although some of the results of this paper are slightly different from the previous research results, most of the results indirectly verify the previous research results. All these results are of great significance for us to understand the variation characteristics of ionospheric irregularities in China and improve the ability of space weather prediction. However, the great difference of occurrences in Xi'an station is striking and worth further studying.

articleTitle: Scannable Beam with Notches Synthesis in Phase-Only Arrays via Convex Optimization
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Antennas, Propagation and EM Theory (ISAPE)
abstract: We propose a phase-only synthesis based on convex optimization to synthesize scannable beam with notches. This method by changing the value range of the weighting, this optimization problem can be converted into convex optimization, which is scannable low sidelobe pattern with notches, when the amplitude dynamic range ratio (DDR) of weighting is given. and the convex optimization can be realized. The effectiveness of the method for scannable beam with notches is verified by an example of 30 element uniform linear array.

articleTitle: Gravity Satellite Altimeter Reveals the Sea Floor Topography
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Antennas, Propagation and EM Theory (ISAPE)
abstract: To address the shortcomings such as the low accuracy or the ability to resist gross error in the process of obtaining the density differences between the gravity data and the seafloor topography by gravity geological method, a new method is proposed to obtain the scale factor parameters by using robust estimation method, which takes into account the influence of gross errors in input data and the contribution of density differences. Through to the marianas trench, the south China sea, part of the Antarctic Ross bay sea area as the research object of adaptive gravity geological method. The results show that in the depth of 3000 m or the terrain is smooth waters, adaptive inversion of gravity geological method can achieve good results, the best constant density differences were 1.50 g/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>, 1.40 g/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>and 4.90 g/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>. In some research areas, the depth model reverted by the adaptive gravity geological method is superior to the ETOPO1 model and the DTU10 model in accuracy, especially in areas with dense ship survey points and areas with flat seabed topography. The adaptive gravity geological method presents more detailed seabed topography and more dense coverage than the current international common sea depth model in some areas.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Wave Propagation Characteristics of Oblique Incidence Nonlinear Ionospheric Langmuir Disturbance
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Antennas, Propagation and EM Theory (ISAPE)
abstract: Based on the generalized Zakharov model, the finite difference time domain (FDTD) method of obliquely incident plasma is combined with the two fluid dynamics equation. The two-dimensional Maxwell equation is equivalent to one-dimensional Maxwell equation, and the numerical model of ionospheric small dip electromagnetic wave propagation is established by using the plasma hydrodynamic equation. In this paper, the governing equation of TEz wave in obliquely incident nonlinear ionospheric plasma is analyzed and derived, and then the FDTD algorithm suitable for calculating the propagation characteristics of ionospheric electromagnetic wave is derived. The simulation results show that when the electromagnetic wave heats the ionosphere with a small inclination, the electromagnetic wave will produce Langmuir disturbance.

articleTitle: Statistical study on VHF Over-the-horizon propagation characteristics from Kunming to Qingdao
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Antennas, Propagation and EM Theory (ISAPE)
abstract: The low end of VHF has HF propagation characteristics, which is called HF up-banding. Based on the measured data of 30MHz~56MHz radio wave propagation in The Link from Kunming to Qingdao for a whole year (From July 15, 2020 to July 14, 2021), the maximum observed frequency and occurrence time of up-banding phenomenon propagation in short-wave are analyzed statistically. The results show that in summer, the probability of up-banding phenomenon is the highest in daytime, the maximum can reach about 70 percent, the up-banding phenomenon basically occurs from sunrise to sunset, and almost no up-banding phenomenon occurs at night. In the whole year, except for the period from May to August, the probability of up-banding phenomenon is very small in other times. In the period from May to August, the maximum probability of up-banding phenomenon greater than 40MHz is up to 50.7 percent, and the maximum probability of up-banding phenomenon greater than 50MHz is 31.4 percent, and the probability of high frequency phenomenon is high.

articleTitle: Influence analysis in the permittivity measurement of the curved materials
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Antennas, Propagation and EM Theory (ISAPE)
abstract: In this paper, an open resonator for permittivity measurement of curved materials is proposed. The resonator consists of the cylindrical cavity and the X-band point-focusing antenna, and the energy in the cavity is coupled into the antenna by hole coupling and then radiated into the free space. When the sample is placed in front of the antenna, the reflection coefficient of the antenna is affected, which in turn causes the resonant mode in the cavity to be perturbed, and the change of its resonant frequency and quality factor depends on the complex permittivity of the material. The variation of measurement results under the effect of different factors is analyzed by measuring samples with different curvatures and thicknesses. The results of the permittivity distribution measurement of the samples show that the method can effectively perform permittivity measurement of curved materials with an error of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup> or less under most measurement conditions, also data fluctuations in a few cases.

articleTitle: Antenna Design and Performance Experimental for Mobile Device 806.11x Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Symposium on Antennas, Propagation and EM Theory (ISAPE)
abstract: This article presents high performance antenna design for 806.11x applications in mobile device. The 806.11x antenna has been realized by using the flexible printed circuit (FPC) substrate and experimental were achieved. The proposed peak gain, total isotropic sensitivity (TIS), intermediate channel scan (ICS), total radiated power (TRP) and effective isotropic sensitivity (EIS) results of printed antenna can be promoting x-, y-, or z-oriented. The proposed design includes performance of radio frequency (RF) with mobile device from 806.11x antenna and the platform effect of Micro LED display on excellence performance of the housing antenna by laser engraving used in mobile device.
